subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should permanent Telegram forum-topic deletion be exposed, and if so must it use a distinct default-off action and configuration gate rather than the existing message-delete path?
rationale: Close and reopen are reversible topic-management operations, but deleteForumTopic permanently removes the topic and its messages under a different Telegram permission; automation cannot choose that product and safety boundary.

options.title: Distinct default-off delete
options.body: Add close/reopen normally and add topic-delete as a separate, explicitly enabled destructive action with its own gate and documentation.

options.title: Lifecycle without deletion
options.body: Add close and reopen now, leaving permanent deletion unsupported until a broader destructive-action policy is approved.

options.title: Enable full lifecycle by default
options.body: Expose close, reopen, and delete without a separate deletion opt-in, accepting the larger destructive blast radius.

recommendation.title: Distinct default-off delete
recommendation.body: Add close/reopen normally and add topic-delete as a separate, explicitly enabled destructive action with its own gate and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent review already framed the unresolved product and safety decision for this exact surface.
